import Base
def constant(unused: Nat) -> Nat: 0n
law constant_equal:
  for x: Nat
  for y: Nat
  {constant(x) == constant(y) : Nat}

import Base
def identity(value: Nat) -> Nat: value
law unjustified_equal:
  for x: Nat
  for y: Nat
  {identity(x) == identity(y) : Nat}
def unjustified_equal(x, y): {==}
